title: Code for: Consensus Within, Competition Between: Decentralized LLM Teams for Perimeter Defense
description:
Code for the paper "Consensus Within, Competition Between: Decentralized LLM Teams for Perimeter Defense" (Abaid Ullah, Acharya and Khojasteh): the simulation, the experiment runners, the analysis that recomputes every number, table and figure of the paper, and the replay viewer.

The data it reads (episode records, cached model answers, analysis outputs) is archived separately on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24208099.
